models.modelDescription: Laya 是一款非自回归式决策模型，支持百余种语言。该模型通过单次前向推理提供类型化的回答及校准后的概率，推理耗时仅 33 毫秒。由于其不生成文本的特性，消除了幻觉风险，特别适用于文本分类、票务处理及各类需要高确定性和快速响应的自动化决策任务。
models.sourceDescription: Multilingual, non-autoregressive System 1 decision model. Give it a state (text, email, ticket, or JSON) and typed questions ; it returns typed answers with mathematically calibrated probabilities in a single forward pass ( 33 ms) across 100+ languages. Trained with reinforcement learning against strictly proper scoring rules ( RLCD ), so reporting honest probabilities is the only way to maximise reward. It never generates text, so there is nothing to parse and nothing to hallucinate.
models.author: convaiinnovations

models.modelDescription: Qwen-Image-2.1-Uncensored-GGUF 是基于 Qwen-Image-2.1 的去审查版本，并提供了 GGUF 格式供本地部署使用。该模型主要用于图像生成任务，移除了原版模型中可能存在的输出限制或过滤机制，方便用户在资源受限的环境下更自由地进行特定内容的图像生成与测试工作。
models.sourceDescription: [!IMPORTANT] The uncensored GGUFs are now available! If you encounter any issues or would like to share your generated images, feel free to post them in the Community section.
models.author: abenzerps

models.modelDescription: Qwen-Image-2.1 是由阿里云通义千问团队推出的多模态模型，具备出色的图像理解与生成能力。该模型能够处理复杂的视觉任务，并在多项基准测试中表现优异。它广泛应用于计算机视觉领域，支持多种框架部署，为开发者提供高效的图像处理与视觉问答解决方案。
models.author: Qwen

models.modelDescription: Audio8-ASR-Infinite 是一款专为实时流式语音识别设计的模型，强调超低延迟与稳定性。它支持自定义音频时钟与转录延迟配置，并经过针对性优化，能够处理无限长度的音频输入。该模型非常适合需要 7/24 小时长时间运行且对响应速度要求极高的语音转文字应用场景。
models.sourceDescription: Audio8 ASR Infinite is a native streaming speech recognition model built to be as responsive as possible. It offers a selectable audio clock (80/120/160 ms) and a transcription delay (240–560 ms). With our adapted vLLM build it transcribes unlimited-length audio 24/7 without drifting.
models.author: Edge0

models.modelDescription: Xing4.0-29B-A4B 是一款高性能大语言模型，提供 Hugging Face Transformers 格式的权重与配置文件。该模型设计旨在与 vLLM、SGLang 及 KTransformers 等主流推理框架无缝兼容，支持高效的计算部署，适用于各种对语言生成能力有较高要求的通用自然语言处理任务。
models.sourceDescription: [!Note] This repository provides the model weights and configuration files for Xing4.0-29B-A4B in Hugging Face Transformers format, compatible with Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, KTransformers, and other mainstream inference frameworks.
models.author: XingChen-AGI
